surface_name: Supabase Storage uploads and storage.objects policies
title: Supabase Storage upload fails with 403 new row violates row-level security policy despite an INSERT policy
symptoms: StorageApiError: new row violates row-level security policy (403)
INSERT policy on storage.objects matches the bucket and auth.uid()
upsert: true uploads fail even when first uploads work
cause: The Storage API inserts the object row and reads it back in the same statement, so a missing SELECT policy fails the whole upload. Overwrites with upsert also need an UPDATE policy.
fix: Add SELECT (and UPDATE if you overwrite) policies on storage.objects that mirror the INSERT policy's bucket and path checks.
affected: Supabase Storage on all plans with RLS on storage.objects
